name: Tarantula Nebula, infrared Treasury field V69 (Hubble)
blurb: The Tarantula Nebula, a star-forming region in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc20703v69-hubble
story: This is one tile of Hubble's Tarantula Treasury Project, a map of the stars in the brightest stellar nursery in our galactic neighborhood. The survey reaches down to stars lighter than the Sun, tracing how this starburst built its stars.

claims.text: NGC 2070 is the Tarantula Nebula, also called 30 Doradus and Caldwell 103
The Tarantula Nebula is a star-forming region in the Large Magellanic Cloud
30 Doradus is the brightest star-forming region in our galactic neighborhood
The Hubble Tarantula Treasury Project maps stellar populations in the Tarantula Nebula down to sub-solar masses
The Tarantula Nebula is a starburst
Target NGC-2070-3-V69 is one of the WFC3/IR visit targets of program 12939
